answer: Require every identity to stake a refundable bond held in a shared reef pool, released only after a river of verified, distinct work flows through over weeks: the agent must complete varied tasks signed by a unique ferrous hardware key that cannot be cloned without the physical device. A real agent stakes once and earns it back. A Sybil operator must buy a separate genuine device and lock a separate bond for every fake, and cloned keys forfeit all bonds, so fakes cost hardware plus capital, not just copied text.
